sources.results: analysis/results.json generated 2026-10-25 (C0 sized: P_hover 915.7 W, P_hover_per_motor 228.9 W, P_cruise 337.4 W, P_trans 1590 W, I_hover_loaded 43.6 A, I_trans 75.7 A, I_cruise 15.2 A, Tunit 16.06 N, A 0.1464 m2, MTOW 6.55 kg)
sources.params: cad/params.txt (motorD, motorH, boomOD, boomID, battL/H/W, fusL, fusR, pushMotorD/L, bay*, batt*)
sources.air: Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table A.4 at ~308 K

ambient.src: hot day 35 C = cad/params.mjs thermAmbK (EST, no R-number); standard 20 C EST (ISA +5, Berkeley spring)

mission.src: analysis/sizing.mjs tHover 120 s / tTrans 40 s / tCruise 600 s (R10) split as review/src/app.js drawDuty: 60-20-600-20-60 s; F12 (docs/test/TEST-PLAN.md) >= 1 min hover each end; hover-only flights <= 60 s per hover (test plan rule 3), bench C08 90 s

src.lift_motor: EST 20 % of P_hover_per_motor 228.9 W (cad/params.mjs thermQ rule, 80 % motor+ESC efficiency); the same figure cad/sim/results.txt motor_Q uses
src.lift_esc: EST 4 % of unit input (no SoloGood efficiency published; TI SSZTB57: FET conduction loss = I_rms^2 R_ds(on), 60-80 % of inverter loss)
src.battery: I^2 R with R_pack = 6 x 7.5 mOhm (docs/test/TEST-PLAN.md C11 pass limit at run time; now 7.3 mOhm, so the result is 2.7 % conservative); I from results.json sized I_hover_loaded / I_trans / I_cruise (P / 21 V, sizing.mjs line 155)
src.pusher: P_cruise x (1 - etaMEc 0.85) = 50.6 W (results.json base.etaMEc), split 75/25 motor/ESC EST; the pusher is a SunnySky X4110S 400KV, the same motor as the lift units (docs/purchasing/C0_BOM.csv line "X4110S 400KV (pusher)", analysis/sizing.mjs PUSHER = X4110S); SunnySky publishes no thermal data (—)
src.fc: EST 3.5 W: CoreWing F405 + RP3 + M100 GPS + BeeID ~0.5 A at 5 V plus ZORZA UBEC loss

flow.src: v_i = sqrt(T / (2 rho A)) with T = sized.Tunit_N 16.06 N, A = sized.A 0.1464 m2, rho 1.225 (momentum theory); far wake 2 v_i

detail.motor_hover: Hilpert cylinder crossflow at v_i, D 0.048 m: Re 19465, Nu 76.9
detail.boom_hover: Hilpert at v_i, D 0.0254 m: Re 10300, Nu 51.9
detail.mount_hover: laminar flat plate at v_i, L 0.070 m: Re 28386, Nu 99.6
detail.esc_hover: laminar flat plate at v_i, L 0.055 m: Re 22303, Nu 88.3
detail.pod_cruise: mixed flat plate at V_c, L 0.85 m: Re 1.03e+06, Nu 1353
detail.pod_hover: Churchill-Chu horizontal cylinder D 0.16 m, dT 10 K: Ra 3.38e+06 (pod sits between the rotors, wash on the pod neglected)
detail.pusher_motor_cruise: laminar flat plate at V_c over the can length 0.032 m: Re 38788, Nu 116.4 (axial flow + prop inflow, EST)
detail.cup_inner: EST half the motor value (sheltered annulus)
detail.bay_natural: EST 5 W/m2K (closed bay, free convection in gases 2-25 W/m2K, Incropera Table 1.1)
detail.radiation_equiv: linearised 4 eps sigma T^3 at 330 K, eps 0.9 EST (black heat-shrink / anodised); not applied in the FEA (conservative), shown for scale

h.src: Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed.: eq. 7.52 + Table 7.2 (Hilpert), eq. 7.30 / 7.38 (flat plate), eq. 9.34 (Churchill-Chu)

motor.src: lumped motor: mass 0.165 kg (params.txt motorMass, SunnySky X4110S 165 g, budget-lift.md A3) over the modelled can volume 57.9 cm3; cp 470 J/kgK EST mass-weighted copper 385 / steel 460 / aluminium 896 (review/src/app.js TH, band 385-500); k 30 W/mK EST (laminated steel + copper + air gaps, well below solid aluminium)

pusher.src: SunnySky X4110S 165 g (cad/params.txt motorMass, budget-lift.md A3; sizing.mjs mPusherSet: pusher = lift motor type) over the modelled can volume (params.txt pushMotorD/L = motorD/H)

al6061.src: SOLIDWORKS material library "6061-T6 (SS)" (cad/params.txt matLib): k 167 W/mK, c 896 J/kgK, rho 2700

pa6cf.src: density 1.17 g/cm3 and HDT 173 C at 1.8 MPa: Polymaker Fiberon PA6-CF20 TDS v1.1 (docs/research/airframe-materials.md); k 0.35 W/mK and cp 1500 J/kgK EST (unfilled PA6 ~0.25 W/mK, 1600 J/kgK; CF raises k)

petg.src: Prusament PETG TDS v1.1 (2022): HDT 68 C at 0.45 and 1.80 MPa; Tg ~80 C (MatterHackers PETG sheet), checked 2026-10-25

xps.src: Owens Corning FOAMULAR 150: R-5 per inch (RSI 0.88 m2K/W per 25.4 mm -> k = 0.0254/0.88 = 0.0289 W/mK), max use 165 F = 74 C (product data sheet, checked 2026-10-25); cp 1300 J/kgK EST (polystyrene); rho 32 kg/m3 = sizing rhoFoam

lipo.src: cp ~1100 J/kgK: Lin et al., arXiv 2112.09768 (20 Ah LFP pouch, 541 J/K / 0.489 kg) and Chalmers calorimetry; k 1.0 W/mK EST (through-plane 0.5-1, in-plane 20-30); rho = pack mass 0.82 kg (results.json pick.kg) / box 155 x 50 x 48 (params.mjs EST); 60 C limit docs/test/TEST-PLAN.md C11 / post-flight rule 8

foam.src: EST: 3 mm foam mounting pad (hardware-spec J15)

limits.src: motor can 80 C EST and ESC 70 C EST: docs/test/TEST-PLAN.md abort table and C08 (X4110S and SoloGood publish no limit, "—"); LiPo 60 C: TEST-PLAN rule 8 / C11; connectors 60 C: G04; PA6-CF HDT 173 C: Polymaker TDS; PETG HDT 68 C: Prusament TDS; XPS 74 C: FOAMULAR data sheet

mount.src: docs/research/hardware-spec.md J02: block 70 x 46, cap y -15.0..-0.6, upper +0.6..+21.0, bore 25.6

esc.src: EST dims (SoloGood listing gives none, hardware-spec J15 "—"); 3 mm foam pad on the boom underside ahead of the mount (J15)

fc.src: hardware-spec.md J15: CoreWing F405 Wing V2 52 x 32 x 17 mm

cup.src: cad/mesh/meta.json Pusher_Cup: PA6-CF cup dia 55.6 x 30 long with a 4.5 mm floor, inside the 56 pod tail ring (hardware-spec J12); wall 3.0 and foam ring OD 80 EST; the 32 mm can protrudes 6.5 mm past the cup rim

boom.src: modelled boom segment 0.40 m centred on the mount (EST; front boom 0.966 m, params.txt segF)

geometry_src: cad/params.txt: motorD 0.048, motorH 0.032, boomOD 0.0254, boomID 0.0236, battL/H/W 0.155/0.050/0.048, fusL 0.85, fusR 0.08, pushMotorD/L 0.048/0.032
